limits: macOS Apple Silicon runtime evidence only; Linux and x86 targets are compile-only
deterministic loopback HTTP qualifies no TLS trust store, live provider, billing, or backend continuation
each row uses a fresh Store and Host so answer bytes and item count grow independently of durable history

the 256 MiB gate uses the conservative upper bound of the cumulative macOS lifetime physical-footprint peak, including display-rounding tolerance; current footprint remains diagnostic, and retained idle is sampled after canonical commit, result verification, zero scratch charge, and released custody
client delivery redirects stdout to a fresh concrete file; macOS time counters cover only the CLI process, while exact destination length and SHA-256 prove complete framing without an added newline
SQLite file bytes include complete private provider items and one public answer; rows do not isolate filesystem cache from process footprint

capacity rows use a single-process selector fixture, one bounded header/hash state and outgoing window per connection, shared immutable valid nonterminal and terminal event bytes, and no thread per stream

capacity overlap is proven by accepted live connections before the active workload; interval A covers event offering through exact post-pause Host consumption, interval B covers terminal delivery through canonical settlement and custody/scratch drain, and their summed Host CPU over summed wall time gates the two-core target

paused footprint and descriptor instrumentation is excluded between the two active CPU intervals and recorded as an explicit gap; the prescribed and achieved 100 event/s/stream schedule still comes from fixture counters and offer elapsed time

qualified whole-Latifa memory samples require zero direct Host descendants before equating aggregate memory to the Host; CPU is Host-process-only, the independent fixture is excluded, and read-result CLI memory is measured separately

process disk-I/O, database/journal write-request, and sync-call counters are unavailable from this macOS measurement surface, so the overall result remains partial even when every runnable dimension passes
SQLite memory is process-global in each one-Store Host; cache use is connection-current approximate and cache spills are connection-cumulative mid-transaction events
spill-on and spill-off rows use fresh Store and Host processes with identical 5 MiB answers while retaining the production 16 MiB SQLite hard heap and durability settings
process termination and restart tests are crash evidence, not power-loss qualification
